Replace.Text: See how to earn Era Score right in the Era panel.

Adds a "How to earn Era Score" section to the Era Progress panel (bottom right). Lists every historic moment that gives Era Score, how much it gives, which ones you can still earn this era, which ones you already earned, and which world firsts were already taken by others. Also lists this era's dedications. UI only: safe to add to or remove from existing saves.
You have reached the Golden Age threshold. Keep going for a Heroic Age if you are in a Dark Age.
[COLOR_Civ6Yellow]{1_Num}[ENDCOLOR] more Era Score for a Golden Age.
[COLOR_Red]{1_Num}[ENDCOLOR] more Era Score to avoid a Dark Age, [COLOR_Civ6Yellow]{2_Num}[ENDCOLOR] more for a Golden Age.
Click a category to expand it. Yellow scores can still be earned this era.
Showing: still earnable (click to show all)
Showing: all (click to show earnable only)
[COLOR_Grey]Chosen when a new era starts. In a Normal or Dark Age most of them give extra Era Score for the actions below.[ENDCOLOR]
(expired: only until the end of the {1_Era})
★ Golden Age into the Classical Era

To enter the Classical Era in a Golden Age, you need enough Era Score during the [COLOR_Civ6Yellow]Ancient Era[ENDCOLOR]. The Golden Age threshold starts at [COLOR_Civ6Yellow]28[ENDCOLOR] and [COLOR_Red]goes up by 1 for every city you own[ENDCOLOR]. The green number after each step is the base Era Score you earned from it this era. No single moment is worth much, so work on several steps at once.

[COLOR_Grey]This is the route for a Golden Age out of the Ancient Era. You are past that era, so it is for reference only. Later eras work the same way: grab this era's firsts and work on several fronts at once.[ENDCOLOR]

· Tribal Village +1 each, [COLOR_Red]Ancient Era only[ENDCOLOR], so the earlier the better[NEWLINE]· Discover a natural wonder +1, first in the world +3[NEWLINE]· Meet a major civ +1 each; meet all of them +3, first in the world +5[NEWLINE]Open with a Scout and send the second one the other way.

· Destroy a Barbarian Outpost +2, +3 if it is near your city, Ancient through Medieval Era[NEWLINE]Once a Scout finds an outpost, send 2 Warriors or Slingers. Kill barbarian scouts first: if one finds your city and gets back to its outpost, the outpost starts sending raiders. 3-4 outposts are worth 8-12.
Build your unique unit / building / district / improvement early (4 each)

· The first of each unique item +4, the biggest single moment in the Ancient Era[NEWLINE]Build one of each unique you can unlock early. In Civilization Conquest Mode, uniques activated from other civs should count too (not tested yet).

· A wonder of the current era +4, of a past era +3[NEWLINE]Pick one Ancient wonder such as Stonehenge, the Pyramids or the Hanging Gardens and chop into it in your capital. In multiplayer, check what the others are building first.
Get a pantheon early (1-2, a religion +2-3 more)
· Found a pantheon +1, first in the world +2[NEWLINE]· Found a religion +2, first in the world +3[NEWLINE]25 Faith is enough for a pantheon; your first Holy Site can also earn step 6.

· The first of each district type with a starting adjacency bonus of [COLOR_Civ6Yellow]+3 or more[ENDCOLOR] +3: Holy Site, Campus, Commercial Hub, Theater Square, Harbor, Industrial Zone[NEWLINE]Place your first Holy Site or Campus next to mountains, rainforest or a natural wonder, and check that the adjacency shows +3 before you place it.

· First tech / first civic of the era +1, first in the world +2[NEWLINE]· Settle next to a natural wonder +3; on desert, tundra, snow, near a volcano or a floodable river +1[NEWLINE]· A city reaching a new size tier for the first time +1, first in the world +2[NEWLINE]· Recruit a Great Person +1; first in the world to become suzerain of a city-state +2

[COLOR_Civ6Yellow]Reminders[ENDCOLOR][NEWLINE]· Every city raises the threshold, so pace your expansion with your score[NEWLINE]· Era Score is tallied the moment the new era starts; once the global era countdown appears, catch up fast[NEWLINE]· Remember to pick a dedication when the Golden Age starts
在时代面板里直接查看怎么获得时代分。
在右下角的时代进度面板里加入“如何获得时代分”：列出所有能给时代分的历史时刻和分值，标出本时代还能拿的、你已经拿过的、已被其他文明抢先的世界首次，并列出本时代可选的致辞。纯界面 MOD，可以随时加入或移出已有存档。
已达到黄金时代的分数线。如果你正处于黑暗时代，下个时代将是英雄时代。
再获得 [COLOR_Civ6Yellow]{1_Num}[ENDCOLOR] 时代分即可进入黄金时代。
再获得 [COLOR_Red]{1_Num}[ENDCOLOR] 时代分可避免黑暗时代，再获得 [COLOR_Civ6Yellow]{2_Num}[ENDCOLOR] 分可进入黄金时代。
点击分类展开。黄色分值表示本时代还能获得。
当前：只看还能拿的（点击显示全部）
当前：显示全部（点击只看还能拿的）
[COLOR_Grey]新时代开始时选择。在普通或黑暗时代，大部分致辞会让下面这些行动额外给时代分。[ENDCOLOR]
想进入古典时代时是黄金时代，就要在[COLOR_Civ6Yellow]远古时代[ENDCOLOR]内攒够分。黄金时代门槛基础 [COLOR_Civ6Yellow]28[ENDCOLOR] 分，[COLOR_Red]每多一座城门槛 +1[ENDCOLOR]。下面每一步后面的绿色数字是这一步本时代已经拿到的基础分。单项分都不高，要几条线同时推进。
[COLOR_Grey]下面是远古时代冲黄金的路线，当前已不在远古时代，只当参考。之后每个时代思路也类似：抢本时代首次，多线并进。[ENDCOLOR]
开局双侦察兵探图（约 8～12 分）
· 部落村庄 +1 / 个，[COLOR_Red]只在远古时代给分[ENDCOLOR]，越早吃越多[NEWLINE]· 发现自然奇观 +1，世界首个发现 +3[NEWLINE]· 遇到主要文明 +1 / 个；遇齐所有主要文明 +3，世界首个遇齐 +5[NEWLINE]首发可以先出侦察兵，第二个侦察兵往反方向走。
清蛮族营地（每个 2～3 分）
· 摧毁蛮族营地 +2，营地在自己城市附近 +3，远古到中世纪都有效[NEWLINE]侦察兵发现营地后，派 2 个勇士或投石兵去打；看到蛮族侦察兵要先打掉，它发现你的城市后跑回营地，营地就会开始刷兵来打你。打掉 3～4 个就是 8～12 分。
尽早造出特色单位 / 建筑 / 区域 / 改良（每种 4 分）
· 每种特色项目第一次造出 +4，是远古单项最高的分[NEWLINE]开局就能造的特色单位，或远古科技解锁的特色建筑、改良，要优先造一个。文明征服模式里，激活其他文明的特色项目后第一次造出，按规则应该也算（还没实测）。
造一个远古奇观（4 分）
· 本时代的奇观 +4，之前时代的奇观 +3[NEWLINE]巨石阵、金字塔、空中花园等远古奇观选一个，首都用砍树加速。联机时先看别人有没有在造，别撞车。
抢万神殿（1～2 分，能建宗教再 +2～3）
· 建立万神殿 +1，世界首个 +2[NEWLINE]· 创立宗教 +2，世界首个 +3[NEWLINE]攒够 25 信仰就能立万神殿；第一座圣地同时还能拿下面第 6 步的分。
首个高相邻区域（每种 3 分）
· 每种区域第一座起始相邻加成 [COLOR_Civ6Yellow]≥ +3[ENDCOLOR] 时 +3：圣地、学院、商业中心、剧院广场、港口、工业区[NEWLINE]第一座圣地或学院不要随手放，选靠山脉、雨林、自然奇观的位置，放下去时看一下相邻数字有没有 +3。
· 本时代首个科技 / 首个市政 +1，世界首个 +2[NEWLINE]· 城市建在自然奇观旁 +3；建在沙漠、冻土、雪地、火山或会泛滥的河边 +1[NEWLINE]· 城市人口第一次达到某个档位 +1，世界首个 +2[NEWLINE]· 招募伟人 +1；世界首个成为城邦宗主国 +2
[COLOR_Civ6Yellow]提醒[ENDCOLOR][NEWLINE]· 多铺城会抬高门槛，铺城要和拿分节奏搭配[NEWLINE]· 时代分在进入新时代那一刻结算，看到全局时代倒计时就要赶紧补分[NEWLINE]· 进了黄金时代后，新时代开始时记得选致辞
